name: NZXT Starter Pro
description: The NZXT Starter Pro is a beautifully designed gaming PC built around the Ryzen 7 7700X and RTX 4070 in NZXT's iconic H7 Flow case. The 360mm AIO liquid cooler keeps temperatures whisper-quiet while the tempered glass side panel showcases the RGB-lit interior. A perfect balance of performance and aesthetics.

name: Corsair Vengeance i7500
description: The Corsair Vengeance i7500 is a no-compromise flagship gaming system powered by the Intel Core i9-14900K and RTX 4090. The massive iCUE 7000X RGB case provides exceptional airflow with six 140mm fans, while Corsair's iCUE software unifies RGB lighting across every component for a synchronized light show.

name: Skytech Archangel 3.0
description: The Skytech Archangel 3.0 is a popular entry-level gaming PC that delivers smooth 1080p gameplay at competitive prices. Featuring the Ryzen 5 5600X and RTX 3060, it handles modern titles at high settings effortlessly. The tempered glass chassis with pre-installed RGB fans makes it a visually appealing first gaming PC.

name: Apple Mac Mini M2 Pro
description: The Apple Mac Mini with M2 Pro chips an incredible amount of computing power into a tiny 19.7cm x 19.7cm footprint. With up to 3x faster CPU performance than the previous Intel model and three display output support, it's the perfect compact workstation for developers, musicians, and creative professionals in the Apple ecosystem.

name: Alienware Aurora R16
description: The Alienware Aurora R16 combines science fiction aesthetics with serious performance via its RTX 4080 Super and Core i7-14700F. The redesigned crescent-shaped chassis delivers significantly improved airflow over previous generations, while Alienware Command Center unifies RGB lighting and performance tuning in one powerful application.

name: HP OMEN 45L
description: The HP OMEN 45L is engineered around a dual-chamber design that physically separates hot components for optimized thermals. The 360mm liquid cooler, RTX 4070 Ti, and tool-free modular chassis make it a premium gaming tower that's as easy to upgrade as it is powerful to game on.

name: CyberPowerPC Gamer Xtreme
description: The CyberPowerPC Gamer Xtreme offers mid-range excellence with a Core i5-13600KF and RTX 4060 Ti combination that handles 1440p gaming with ease. The RBG-illuminated tempered glass tower, WiFi 6E, and Windows 11 Home make it a well-rounded, ready-to-play system at a compelling value.

name: Intel NUC 13 Pro
description: The Intel NUC 13 Pro packs a surprisingly capable Core i7 into a palm-sized 4x4 inch chassis, making it the ultimate space-saving desktop for office environments, digital signage, or home theater setups. Thunderbolt 4, WiFi 6E, and dual 4K display support make it an incredibly versatile mini PC despite its diminutive size.

name: MSI MEG Aegis Ti5
description: The MSI MEG Aegis Ti5 is a jaw-dropping gaming monolith featuring an integrated 6-inch touchscreen control panel, motorized RGB lighting pendulums, and exceptional RTX 4080 + Core i9 performance. Its unique design and MSI Center software make it a conversation-starting centerpiece for any hardcore gaming battlestation.

name: Yeyian Yumi Gaming PC
description: The Yeyian Yumi is a budget-friendly AMD-powered gaming desktop that delivers solid 1080p performance with the Ryzen 5 7600 and RX 7600. Its tempered glass side panel, pre-installed RGB fans, and full PCIe 5.0 support for future upgrades make it an excellent starting point for PC gaming without breaking the bank.
